scope: Gate BTC_USDT spot and USDT-settled perpetual; documentary review only
acquisition: Public official pages read through web research; no exchange API or market archive acquisition
network_count_note: The browser/search service does not expose its underlying HTTP attempt count.

sources.finding: A dated spot fee adjustment exists. The notice also anticipates currency-class tiering; it is not a complete subsequent fee-change ledger.
sources.exclusion: No January 2023 coverage; no verified uninterrupted validity through January 2025, pair class, or account discount assumptions. No extrapolation of the announced rate.

sources.announced_month_day_time: May 20, 08:00-12:00 UTC; body does not independently establish year
sources.finding: The served publication header and footer disagree by one year. The rate table cannot resolve its own effective year.
sources.exclusion: Conflicting publication year and no complete historical validity interval.

sources.finding: Delivery-futures changes, BTC-M perpetual zero fees, and BTC/USDT spot maker relief are different scopes. Spot taker fees remain VIP-dependent.
sources.exclusion: BTC-M is not the USDT-settled perpetual route; maker relief does not establish taker costs. Neither selected January sample is covered by a verified interval.

sources.finding: The change concerns GT holdings needed for VIP qualification, not a dated BTC_USDT execution fee series.
sources.exclusion: No historical fee ledger and no evidence of a simulated account's eligibility for discounts.

sources.finding: The new funding-rate-limit field is illustrated with a contract response. This is not an archived contract-state capture for either January sample.
sources.exclusion: Later illustrative response cannot establish earlier contract units or an unchanged interval.

sources.finding: For USDT-settled contracts, multiplier times token price gives per-contract notional. Book current and update have different meanings. The single-contract endpoint documents settle and contract parameters, not an as-of-date selector.
sources.exclusion: Schema and example timestamps establish semantics, not a verified historical parameter interval or actual receive-time history.

discovery_only_sources.use: Followed the link to the original spot fee notice 34105. Bot promotion rates are not imported into model costs.

limits: Bounded review of selected official notices, not exhaustive proof that no historical evidence exists anywhere.
Only paraphrased facts and URLs are retained; this is not an immutable archive of remote page bytes.
No rate, multiplier, discount or effective interval from this audit is inserted into trading inputs.
